notes.title: News
notes.notes:
Dear gamers and enthusiasts,

We regret to inform you that REMOTE LIFE will not be available for purchase at this moment due to forthcoming company and internal changes. We kindly ask for your patience and understanding during this period if you experience any difficulty in acquiring the game. Rest assured, we will promptly notify you as soon as there are updates.

Thank you immensely for your continued support and understanding.

Warm regards,

notes.title: REMOTE LIFE 2 ! Wishlist of new features !
notes.notes:
Hi, Remote Life 2 is in the planing. It will continue the Story of John Leone !
I would love if you guys would  like to make suggestions: for enemies, special levels, weapons , game mechanics or any other feature that might make Remote Life 2 great ! Im working also on a few minor Game titles and will post them as soon they are ready. Im planing also a new update of Remote Life, espacially for the achivements ( when you complete a level in a higher difficulty level, you will unlock also the lower difficulty levels). You can write the suggestions in the HUB where I have pinned a special discussion !

I have a little request for all gamers who liked Remote Life. It is very important for a solo Indie Game Developer to have a certain number of Positive comments on the store page. I ask you kindly for a little  support by posting a nice comment (it takes just 1 minute, but would make such a big difference :). [b]Thank you ![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35492785/cd749b05dd0042c5b7813ad282d5278f79ce586d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.4: for casual Gamers + more bonus
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35492785/269dfb954407cc274a20e47982ba69eebdc96ed0.jpg[/img]

Important for who was playing with lower versions, especially with version 1.0 - 1.2

1.) Added a 4th difficulty level. Now the easy mode is easier than before. This has been changed for gamers who are not experts in this genre and for casual gamers (this last version is also easier than v1.3 that had already an easy mode).

2.) Gamers start now with 5 lives and not with 4 lives. 

3.) On Boss Fight you can collect an extra life if you have left only one.

4.) In the last Bonus you can download 2 additional amazing 3D Statues. You can print them with any 3D Printer or from any 3D print online service.

HAVE FUN !
